preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.
The input string contains only alphanumeric characters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join([c * (int(prev_num) if prev_num else 1) for c, prev_num in zip(s, [None] + [s[i] if s[i].isdigit() else None for i in range(len(s)-1)])]) if s else ''
postconditions.description: The output is constructed by iterating through the string; each character is repeated 'n' times where 'n' is the most recent preceding digit, or 1 if no preceding digit exists. Consecutive digits cause the earlier digit to be ignored (overwritten by the later one before any character is processed). Consecutive letters mean the first letter uses the current multiplier and the second letter uses the same multiplier (since no new digit appeared between them).

postconditions.expression: not any(c.isdigit() for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string contains no numeric characters.
An empty input string results in an empty output string.
